role: The NBT file layer: reads and writes compounds from files, streams and byte arrays, with gzip wrapping and the root-tag framing (type byte, empty name) that region files, player data and the snapshot digests sit on.
scope_reason: The binary form its write path produces is exactly what the d.ents digest hashes, and its read path is what loads region files; snapshots need both. Deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: readCompressed
members.note: GZIP-wrapped compound read; region.c inflates with zlib before the binary reader. (Java's region files use the same Inflater over the chunk stream.)

members.name: writeCompressed
members.note: its callers write save files (SaveHandler, MapStorage, SaveFormatOld); the native engine writes none by the product decision in the IntegratedServer record (Java writes every checkpoint), so no gzip output exists to match

members.name: func_152457_a
members.note: Decompress a byte array and read; the native readers take the inflated buffer directly.

members.name: compress
members.note: its callers are PacketBuffer.writeNBTTagCompoundToBuffer (the wire form of a stack's or tile entity's tag) and the save paths above; native messages are structs that carry the tag itself, and readNBTTagCompoundFromBuffer's func_152457_a gives the client back the same tag, so the compressed bytes have no consumer

members.name: safeWrite
members.note: Temp-file-then-rename atomic save of world data; the native engine keeps its state in memory and snapshots on demand.

members.name: write
members.note: its callers are MapStorage.getUniqueDataId's idcounts.dat (reached only from ItemEmptyMap.onItemRightClick and ItemMap: world.conf maps = off) and AnvilSaveConverter (converting an old-format save; every world here is created new); chunks and level.dat go through the stream forms

members.name: read
members.note: its callers are MapStorage.getUniqueDataId's idcounts.dat (reached only from ItemEmptyMap.onItemRightClick and ItemMap: world.conf maps = off) and AnvilSaveConverter (converting an old-format save; every world here is created new); chunks and level.dat go through the stream forms

members.name: func_152458_a
members.note: read(File)'s body; its callers are MapStorage.getUniqueDataId's idcounts.dat (reached only from ItemEmptyMap.onItemRightClick and ItemMap: world.conf maps = off) and AnvilSaveConverter (converting an old-format save; every world here is created new); chunks and level.dat go through the stream forms

members.name: read
members.note: Stream read of a framed root compound.

members.name: write
members.note: The digest form: type byte 10, writeUTF of the empty name, then the compound payload; proven byte for byte by the d.ents SHA-1 chain on the replayed mob-free tapes.

members.name: func_150663_a
members.note: Writes the type byte, the name and the payload for any tag; the whole binary writer lives in nbtbin.c.

members.name: func_152455_a
members.note: Reads one framed tag by type.

members.name: CompressedStreamTools
members.note: a holder of static members: oracle/src has no `new CompressedStreamTools(` anywhere, so the implicit ctor never runs

notes: The read and write directions that state flows through in this engine are proven: region chunks in test_populate.c (35 overworld regions plus the Nether and End) and the binary digest form in the whole-tape replay gates. The write-to-file and safeWrite paths are dead in the native engine by design, not gaps in ported behavior. lane/idxclient: writeCompressed and compress are n/a (reasons on the members, checkable by grepping oracle/src for their callers); every in-scope member is exact.
